Introduction

This is a sample HTML document used for integration testing of the RAG kernel parsing pipeline. It contains multiple sections with headings, paragraphs, and a table.

Key Concepts

The RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pattern combines information retrieval with language model generation. Documents are parsed, chunked, enriched with metadata, and stored as vector embeddings for semantic search.

Architecture

The system uses a provider pattern for all external dependencies. Each component (parser, chunker, embedder, vector store) implements an abstract interface, allowing easy swapping of implementations.

Components

ComponentImplementationPurpose
ParserDoclingDocument structure extraction
EmbedderJina v3Dense vector generation
Vector DBQdrantSimilarity search
StorageMinIORaw document storage

Conclusion

This document serves as a test fixture for validating the end-to-end ingestion pipeline. It exercises heading detection, paragraph chunking, and table extraction.
